passages.name: And did you succeed?

passages.text:
Two ways out of here. First is the main door — straight to the cockpit, exactly where you need to be. Easy access to the distress beacon…But its locked.
Second option: the ventilation system. Longer, cramped, and it doesn’t reach the cockpit.
The door only opens from the centralized AI in the control room. Get there, connect me to the main computer, so i can unlock the door and we can call the distress beacon.
Would you like to see a map?
